race.comment: RUNKLE CRUNCH NZ (5) put the writing on the wall with a fresh placing from the back row in the Chandon Classic at Pinjarra then took advantage of a better draw last time, leading for a 3.7m win in the 4YO Championship at this circuit and distance. Should push forward again from this barrier so can go on with it. MAD MONDAY (4) impressed when resuming last week, working forward to lead from a wider draw before cruising home by close to 13m. This is stronger but he should be improved and is building an imposing record at this circuit and distance. The winning run of CYCLONE JORDY NZ (9) came to an end last start but he did have to work and was only second-up after a year on the sidelines. Draws out but he had been the benchmark horse of this generation before that layoff so must be given another chance. BELLY UP (2) has done well to place in Group races at his last couple and is worth including from another low draw.
